name: Boku dake ga Shitteiru
original_name: ボクだけがしっている
source:
After a long hospital stay, Akira was worried about a female college student, "Misaki", who was a fellow patient.

It seems that she has promised to meet a man whom she became close to on SNS...

[From [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/7327]NovelGame[/url]]

This visual novel is something of a fandisc for all the previous VNs from the same developer, and as such it contains spoilers and bonus after stories for characters from those games. Proceed with caution.
translation:
经过漫长的住院治疗后，Akira开始担心同病房的女大学生“Misaki”。

听说她已经和一位在社交网络上认识的男人约好见面…

[来源：[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/7327]NovelGame[/url]]

本作有点像同一开发者此前所有视觉小说的粉丝向衍生作，因此包含剧透，以及那些作品角色的番外后日谈。游玩前请谨慎。
